name: Zero Trust Feature Team
description: Eight agents and eight slash commands turn a one-line feature request into a tracked implementation pipeline. Independent verification at every gate—no code is written until you approve the plan. State persists across /clear in .claude/feature-state/. Commands: /feature:init, /feature:research, /feature:plan, /feature:review, /feature:implement
longDescription:
Ships **8 agents** and **8 commands**.

- **Agents** (8): `feature-implementer` (Applies exactly ONE planned step per invocation), `feature-orchestrator` (Coordinates the zero-trust feature implementation team), `feature-planner` (Builds the implementation plan from confirmed requirements and complete research), `intake-analyst` (Gathers feature requirements from the user with adversarial completeness), `plan-critic` (Independently reviews the implementation plan before any code is written), `project-researcher` (Zero-trust codebase researcher), `step-verifier` (Independent verifier of an implemented step), `test-engineer` (Writes behavior tests for each implemented step and runs the existing test suite against the change)
- **Commands** (8): `continue` (Resume a paused research run from the last STATUS: PARTIAL marker), `implement` (Implement one approved step through implementer -> test-engineer -> step-verifier), `init` (Bootstrap a zero-trust feature implementation), `plan` (Build the ordered implementation plan from the confirmed task and complete research), `research` (Research the codebase area-by-area against the confirmed task), `review` (Independent review of the plan, plus user approval), `status` (Show current feature progress, pre-implementation gate state, step status, and next recommended action), `summary` (Produce the final feature implementation report)

Installs with `claude plugin install zero-trust-feature-team@claude-community` from `bradselph/zero-trust-feature-team`.
